**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 73 **Archetype** [Swarmkeeper](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=223) **Prerequisites** [Swarmkeeper Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5463) --- Your swarm takes on characteristics of the death cicadas of the Mana Wastes, whose distinctive buzz is said to be a herald of imminent demise. The inclusion of these death cicadas grants your swarm a fly Speed of 20 feet. You also gain the Death Drone action. **Death Drone** ([auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=541), [flourish](/Traits.aspx?ID=606), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647)) The cicadas in your swarm make a droning sound that stimulates a fear response. Each creature within your swarm's space takes 6d4 mental damage and must attempt a Will save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. **Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.
**Success** The creatures takes half damage.
**Failure** The creature takes full damage, is [frightened 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76), and takes a –2 circumstance penalty to Perception checks that require hearing.
**Critical Failure** The creature takes double damage, is frightened 2, and is [deafened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=66) until the start of your next turn.
name: Buzzing Death Cicadas
